s.note: delivered straight to Mr. Hand's class
s.how: Roll out 500g pizza dough and cut into 16 rounds. Spread with pizza sauce and top with grated mozzarella and a slice of pepperoni. Bake at 230C for 8 minutes and serve in a pizza box.

s.n: Food court pretzels with cheddar sauce
s.how: Brush 4 soft pretzels with 30g melted butter, sprinkle with coarse salt and warm at 200C for 5 minutes. Heat 375ml evaporated milk in a saucepan until steaming, then take off the heat and stir in 200g grated cheddar and half a tsp mustard powder until smooth. Pour into 4 paper cups and serve with the pretzels and a squeeze of yellow mustard.

m.note: the burger joint at the mall
m.how: Shape 800g chuck mince into 4 patties and grill to medium, melting cheddar on top. Build on toasted sesame buns with iceberg, tomato, onion and pickles. Fry 1kg potatoes cut into fries, twice, and salt well.

w.n: Food court brown butter choc chip cookies
w.note: the cookie stand at the food court
w.how: Cook 150g butter until it smells nutty and goes golden, then cool for 15 minutes. Beat with 200g brown sugar, 1 egg and 1 tsp vanilla. Mix in 250g plain flour, half a tsp bicarb soda, a pinch of salt and 200g dark choc chips. Cover and chill overnight. Scoop 10 big balls onto lined trays and bake at 180C for 11 minutes, then cool on the tray for 10 minutes.

d.note: the mall food court, all summer
d.how: Blend 250g hulled strawberries with 500ml milk, 2 tbsp sugar, 1 tsp vanilla and 2 cups ice until frothy and thick. Pour into 4 tall glasses straight away.
